articles.title: S. Korea, US vow to strengthen cooperation to accelerate wartime OPCON transition in defense talks
articles.description: Korea and the United States pledged to reinforce cooperation to accelerate the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul from Washington during their senior-level defense talks this week, a joint statement said Friday.
